items.title: Same-completed-bar window progression (pre-market → morning) holds Tier-A coverage and persistence FLAT while only an off-hours crypto leg drifts: the morning snapshot (asOf 2026-08-02T14:30:22.947Z) advances the intraday window but the completed-bar frontier stays 2026-07-31 (287/287 fresh, 0 carried, 0 missing), so no headless adapter re-flips, richCount/coverageCount hold 12/10, and no persistence counter increments - the sole change is BTC-USD easing a further notch (31.1 → 30.9) on its unchanged 2026-08-02 daily stamp
items.note: Distinct from the prior window's 'bar-append unlocks coverage' pattern (07-30 → 07-31 append). This run consumes a NEWER snapshot but the SAME completed equity bar: (1) BAR FRONTIER UNCHANGED: dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate is still 2026-07-31 with freshSymbolCount 287 / 287, carriedSymbolCount 0, missingSymbolCount 0 (updated 2026-08-02T14:30:14.934Z) - the 07-31 append already happened in the prior pre-market window, so this morning window re-prices the identical bar. (2) COVERAGE HELD FLAT: the split is unchanged at richCount 12 / coverageCount 10 - the same 12 tools stay fresh-headless newly-authored (heatmap 48.64% narrow, intraday Trend day up VWAP 744.46, swing Bull-stacked Double-top below-threshold, options-structure positive gamma flip 740.09 walls 741/749 EM ±4.27, gamma pin-to-maxpain patient, volatility-sizing forecast 13.9101% throttle ×1.08, plus sector/global-rotation/real-assets/etf-momentum/company-fundamentals) and none flips STALE↔ANALYZED. (3) LEVELS BYTE-IDENTICAL: VIX 15.99 (band 'VIX 16.0', score 0), SPY 747.03, ma50Dist +0.38%, ma200Dist +7.12%, -1.4% from the 52w high, mom126 +8.21%, mom252 +19.05%; the sector RRG is identical (XLY into quad I accel +0.9, XLE out quad L, XLV leader quad W). (4) PERSISTENCE NOT INCREMENTED: because no NEW distinct completed bar date exists, the identical XLY rotate-into keeps its prior distinct-bar count (early-persistent across [07-30, 07-31] = 2) and the structural tools keep theirs (07-31 = 1); a repeated intraday run must not advance either. The lone drift is the daily-dated bitcoin leg easing 31.1 → 30.9 (still Downtrend, asOf 2026-08-02T00:00:00.000Z), an off-hours quote change on the completed 07-31 bar - not itself a bar advance. Signature: an intra-bar window progression can add zero coverage and zero persistence even though the snapshot clock moved forward.
items.method: Add an 'intra-bar window progression' detector that fires when a NEWER snapshot advances the window WITHOUT advancing the completed-bar frontier. Trigger on FOUR tests: (1) WINDOW ADVANCES BUT BAR DOES NOT = snapshot.window changes (here pre-market → morning) while dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate is UNCHANGED versus the prior window (here still 2026-07-31) with freshSymbolCount == symbolCount and carriedSymbolCount == 0 and missingSymbolCount == 0 (287/287, 0, 0) - a same-bar re-price, NOT an append; (2) COVERAGE HELD FLAT = richCount/coverageCount are unchanged (12/10) and no tool flips STALE↔ANALYZED versus the prior window; (3) LEVELS UNCHANGED = regime + bench are byte-identical (VIX 15.99 / band 'VIX 16.0' / score 0; SPY 747.03 / +0.38% / +7.12% / +8.21% / +19.05%) and the sector RRG metrics are identical (XLY into, XLE out, XLV leader); (4) PERSISTENCE MUST NOT INCREMENT = because no NEW distinct completed bar date exists, an identical read keeps its prior distinct-bar count (XLY stays early-persistent across [07-30, 07-31] = 2; the structural tools stay at 1 = [07-31]). HARD RULE: count persistence by DISTINCT completed market-bar dates only - a repeated intraday run (pre-market → morning) on the SAME 07-31 bar does NOT increment the counter, and an off-hours re-priced crypto quote (BTC-USD easing 31.1 → 30.9 on its unchanged 2026-08-02 daily stamp) is likewise NOT a completed-equity-bar advance and does not increment persistence.

bars.note: The completed 07-31 daily session was appended in the prior pre-market window; this morning window re-prices the SAME 07-31 bar without advancing the frontier (287/287 fresh, 0 carried, 0 missing).
